name: kaspa-x402
description: Specification and reference implementation for x402 payments on Kaspa.

scripts.build: npm --prefix protocol run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway run build:self
scripts.test: npm --prefix protocol test && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway run build:self && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway run test:self && node --test scripts/proof-hosted-exact.test.mjs
scripts.site:deploy:check: node scripts/site-build.mjs --require-clean && node --test scripts/site-markdown.test.mjs && node scripts/site-check.mjs --require-clean
scripts.check:browser-demo: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm run site:build && node scripts/check-browser-demo.mjs
scripts.check:demo-gateway: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway run build && node scripts/check-demo-gateway.mjs
scripts.validate:release: npm test && npm run validate:schemas && npm run site:deploy:check && npm run check:site-input-guards && npm run check:browser-demo && npm run check:hash-chain-worker && npm run check:pnn-browser && npm run check:vendor-wasm && npm run check:worker-types && npm run check:demo-gateway && npm run check:admin-security && npm run check:hosted-offer-pins && npm run check:covenant-fixtures && npm run check:hash-chain-fixture && npm run validate:tx-v1-consensus && npm run check:sighash-consensus-vector && npm run check:exact-consensus-vector && npm run check:hash-chain-consensus-vector && npm run check:hash-chain-http-vector && npm run check:exact-http-vector && npm run check:exact-interop-vector && npm run check:batch-interop-vector && npm run proof:offline && npm run proof:live:check -- --write-report && npm run pack:public:dry-run >/tmp/kaspa-x402-pack.json && npm run check:diff
scripts.validate:release:live: npm run validate:release && npm run proof:live:check -- --live --write-report
scripts.check:hash-chain-worker: npm run build && npm run site:build && node scripts/check-hash-chain-worker.mjs
